Best Value Electric Bicycles for Adults in Canada

LIBRA E-Bike 26" | Adult Urban Commuter | Eco-Friendly, High Comfort, Shock-Absorbing Pedal Assist Bike
How to Assemble Your 26-Inch LIBRA Electric Bike？https://youtu.be/uuECr96WA3c

Excellent Riding Experience:This electric bike is equipped with 26-inch tires. The lockable front fork suspension reduces vibration caused by bumpy road conditions, and the 7-speed transmission easily overcomes rough road conditions. The dual disc brake and lighting system ensure your riding safety.

Large Capacity Battery and Brushless Motor:The bicycle is equipped with a 36V, 11.6Ah battery. You can use second gear assist for driving, with a maximum range of 43-46.6 miles (70-75 kilometers) per charge. A 500W (Peak 750W) rear drive offers a top speed of 32 kilometers per hour (20 miles per hour). The powerful brushless motor provides a low interference, low noise, quiet, and smooth riding experience.

Durable and Sturdy:Electric bicycles use a lower frame to make getting on and off more convenient and effectively reduce riding resistance, providing a high-speed and smooth riding experience. The parallel bars design increases the strength of the body to ensure sufficient durability and safety.

Multiple Speed Modes:This electric bicycle has 5 speed modes, cruise control, and push assist functions, which perfectly meet the traffic demand of going to work or going out. Choose the appropriate riding speed according to your needs and easily provide more convenience for your work and life.

Reliable After-Sales Service:This e-bike comes 85% pre-assembled. Assembly can be quickly completed after unboxing. Different accessories for bicycles come with a one-year or 180-day warranty. If you encounter any problems, please feel free to contact us, and we are always ready to assist you.C INVERTER Electric Bike
